notes.title: Sbeve v0.2.8
notes.notes:
-Fixed bug in which when you die you can’t respawn

-Fixed a bug where load game would break the game if you have died previously

-Fixed bug where the parkour prize was hard to see/ blend in with the background

-Fixed issue where the dungeon ground would be destructible

-Added more variety to the ground and surroundings

-Fixed the ability to mine while talking to NPCs

notes.title: Fixed Achievements and Other Quality of Life Fixes
notes.notes:
-Fixed steam achievements

-Fixed minor bugs in the speech of the character

-Fixed bug with AI not taking damage

-Fixed bug with AI not tracking the player in the spawn 

-Fixed bug where the Boss was dealing 30% more damage in the first phase of the attack

-Fixed bug with the jetpack running out of fuel to quick

-Fixed an issue where you start with 2000 nuts & bolts
